senses.def: A Paiute religious leader, also known as Jack Wilson (c.1856 - 1932), who founded a second episode of the Ghost Dance movement.
made on a mould of closely woven wire
writing paper having a very faint mesh pattern
made or constructed by interlacing threads or strips of material or other elements into a whole

ex: Woven kevlar is tough enough to be bulletproof.
The woven words of the sonnet were deep and moving.

senses.def: A cloth formed by weaving. It only stretches in the bias directions (between the warp and weft directions), unless the threads are elastic.
ex: A factory that makes cotton and other wovens.
